title: Connecting AI Agents to Live Discrete Element Simulations via the Model Context Protocol
abstract: arXiv:2611.33926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper describes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server through which a general-purpose AI agent operates a discrete element engine, commercial or open-source, while the simulation runs. The agent submits a long simulation to the engine and, while it computes, reads the running model, changes it, or stops it. The human modeler stays at the engine's console and graphical interface throughout, and the agent sees what the modeler does there. The tools are derived from what the agent needs to do at the engine and are held to four principles: correctness, coverage, orthogonality and simplicity. Two documentation tools let the agent search the engine's manual and browse it level by level. Five execution tools let the agent run code in the engine, submit long simulations in the background, check on them, read the running model, and stop them. A bridge inside the engine serves these tools in a commercial DEM engine, PFC, and an open-source

translated_title: 通过模型上下文协议（MCP）将AI智能体连接到实时离散元模拟
translated_abstract: 本文描述了一个模型上下文协议服务器，通用AI智能体可通过该服务器在模拟运行期间操作离散元引擎（商业或开源均可）。智能体将一个长时间运行的模拟提交给引擎，并在计算过程中读取正在运行的模型、修改它或停止它。人类建模者全程留在引擎的控制台和图形界面处，智能体则可以看到建模者在那里的操作。这些工具源自智能体在引擎处需要执行的任务，并遵循四项原则：正确性、覆盖性、正交性和简洁性。两个文档工具使智能体能够搜索引擎手册并逐级浏览手册内容。五个执行工具使智能体能够在引擎中运行代码、在后台提交长时间模拟、检查模拟状态、读取正在运行的模型以及停止模拟。引擎内部的桥接组件在商业DEM引擎PFC和一个开源引擎中提供这些工具的服务。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于MCP协议的服务器，使通用AI智能体能够在离散元模拟实时运行过程中操作、监控和修改商业或开源DEM引擎，实现人类建模者与AI智能体协作的交互式模拟控制。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an MCP server that enables a general-purpose AI agent to operate, monitor, and modify live discrete element simulations in commercial or open-source DEM engines while they run, achieving interactive human-AI collaborative simulation control.
